I am a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University, with a Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) from St. Xavier's College in Kolkata.

My background is in finance. I've worked as a junior financial analyst at a not-for-profit hospital, where I tracked foreign funding and helped keep it compliant with government regulations, and I recently completed an internship analysing and comparing mutual funds for a financial and investment advisory firm. I am still learning, and I enjoy using computational tools to turn data into actionable stories. This site is where I practise explaining my data stories.

I am particularly interested in applying data science to financial and healthcare problems. Through my projects, I have explored time-series analysis, forecasting, and machine learning techniques to predict mortality indicators and identify meaningful patterns in data. I am also interested in understanding how unexpected changes in human behaviour and real-world conditions can disrupt established patterns and create challenges for reliable prediction.
